metadata.case_name: CHAN CHUNG KUEN v. MTR CORPORATION LTD

injuries.description: fracture of distal third of his left tibia
source: X-ray showed fracture of distal third of his left tibia and left fibula neck (leg).
They agreed on the diagnosis of left tibia shaft spiral fracture and left proximal fibular fracture.
X-ray showed fracture of distal third of his left tibia and left fibula neck (leg).

manifestations.description: intermittent pain in the left lower leg
continuous numbness in the left lower leg
mild wasting of muscles of the left thigh and mild to moderate wasting of the left calf muscles
limping; could walk unaided with some limping
needed support to stand for half an hour (reduced standing tolerance)
decrease in dexterity of the left lower leg
temporary loss of consciousness for about 10 seconds (pleaded by plaintiff)

treatments_received: left long leg plaster cast slab for temporary immobilisation
close reduction and internal fixation of the left tibia (performed 5 days after injury)
transfer to Tai Po Hospital for rehabilitation and physiotherapy
treatments_future: removal of the metal implants (advised by Dr Ko as advisable)

losses.description: Permanent impairment of left leg with residual pain, numbness, muscle wasting and decreased dexterity
Reduced walking and standing tolerance; limping
Reduced efficiency in handling pre-accident work and loss of earning capacity
